prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a complete production-ready Chinese Vue 3 desktop educational workspace screenshot for MajorPilot at 1536x1024. It is an actual guided Data Science professional experience for prospective postgraduate students, not an analytics dashboard or landing page. Preserve existing editorial system: exact warm paper background #F7F5EE, ink #171A1D, vivid blue #304FFE actions, orange #F45B35 huge serif step number. Top header 76px tall: existing simple blue/orange folded-paper MajorPilot brand left, thin vertical divider, "DS · 学习行为分析", right "已保存" and "暂停并返回". Left navigation width 288px under header, central scrollable workspace to x1176, right help rail width360 with thin rules, no cards/no shadows/no gradients. Header remains at top and bottom footer is fixed within viewport from y932 with "上一​​步" left and black primary button "完成此步骤" with blue edge and circle right-arrow. Right rail title "需要一点提示？", body "先自己尝试。你可以按需逐层查看提示。", three rule-separated rows "01 概念方向", "02 操作思路", "03 一个具体线索", outlined blue "查看一级提示". Left nav heading "任务步骤", seven rows: "理解字段与问题","检查数据质量","查看初步分布","探索变量关系","检查解释","写出分析结论","体验反思". Bottom left "返回专业入口 →", "DS · 工程预览 · v1.0.0", and small orange-left-rule "工程预览；尚待专业审核与真实用户计时". Large40px Chinese black headings,18px body,16px controls/captions. Keep airy deliberate hierarchy with thin rules and open layout rather than cards. Native HTML controls/tables/SVG charts later, no raster UI shipped. No unrelated areas, no fake scores, no hero kicker/pill/badge. Real task fields may extend below first viewport in middle scroll area; don't miniaturize. This concept is a design reference, not an implemented result. Current step02 orange number02, highlight second nav row blue. Central heading "检查数据质量". Supporting copy "先辨认缺失、重复和极端值，再决定如何处理。保留原始数据，每次计算都记录你的选择。". A compact native table "原始数据概览" columns "项目","含义": "360 行" / "359 名合成学员与 1 条完全重复记录"; "缺失与不适用" / "分别计数，不把 null 当成 0". Do not show any other unverified metric. Native fieldset "发现了哪些问题？" with three empty checkboxes "明确重复","记录缺失","合理极端值". Then rule-separated select rows "重复记录" default "保留记录", "记录缺失" default "保留缺失", "极端值" default "保留原值". Muted explanation "缩尾会改变测量值，不代表极端值就是错误。". Two side by side empty textareas "重复处理的理由","缺失处理的理由". Outlined button "运行质量检查", caption "固定计算器；服务端复核结果。". Folded disclosure "查看等价 Python 说明（只读，不执行）". No disabled gray result skeleton, no fabricated results.
